title: Pause TASK-0046 until its design (TASK-0053) is done
summary: Sets TASK-0046 (decision record kind and DEC trace tags) back from in-progress to todo. It can restart once TASK-0053 is done.
rationale: Product owner decision: TASK-0046 was already in progress when CS-0021 made it depend on design task TASK-0053, which is still todo. Pausing it keeps the code from running ahead of its design.

stories: STORY-0019 keeps its status; no scope change.
code: Any work-in-progress for TASK-0046 (on a reqforge/TASK-0046 agent branch or locally) is not touched. Keep it for when the task restarts, and reconcile it with design/decisions.md once TASK-0053 is done.
risks: If an agent run for TASK-0046 is active, cancel it from the task drawer; changing the status does not stop a running agent.
With the agent queue on, TASK-0046 restarts automatically once TASK-0053 is done.
